Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the processing of 802.11 frames. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in a write past the end of an allocated data structure. title: (0Day) Realtek RTL8811AU Wi-Fi Driver rtwlane Out-Of-Bounds Write Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of the Realtek RTL8811AU Wi-Fi driver. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the processing of 802.11 frames. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in a write past the end of an allocated data structure. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the kernel.
